meta.title: dsh-ops
meta.description: Provides optional Bash and native Rust tools for DSH to improve token efficiency; PowerShell remains host-managed

en.bashHint: Use an absolute path. Clear the override to inherit the configured default.
en.discoverHelp: Always-loaded choices remain available when discovery is off. Permissions still apply to every call.
en.invalidLimit: Choose a whole number from 1 to 5.
en.noRuntime: Runtime controls require an enabled shell row and the host runtime services.
en.poolHelp: Removing a capability from the allowed pool also removes it from the always-loaded selection.
en.pwshHelp: This updates the standard PowerShell 7 installation through WinGet. Restart DSH afterwards. Review a custom host pwshPath separately; Windows PowerShell 5.1 is preserved.
en.rejected: The host refused this save. Reset to the latest saved values and review your changes.
en.replacementPool: Keep inspect_local_file for read, or glob/grep for search, always loaded in Discovery or activate them before selecting a replacement. read_files is not the read counterpart.
en.replacements: Choose which official tools OPS replaces.
en.replacementsHelp: Selected tools use OPS argument and output contracts. Read is bounded UTF-8; search excludes hidden files and links. Leave a tool unchecked to keep the official workflow.
en.runtimeHelp: Installations do not change your saved executor choice. Stop Bash jobs before removing a managed installation.
en.saved: Saved. The host reloaded this row.
en.selectionHint: Review the selected path, then save the shell settings.
en.shell: Manage Bash and the standard host PowerShell installation.
en.unavailable: Enable this row with the built-in switch to edit its settings. A writable host profile is required.
en.unknownEffect: Changes may have occurred. Inspect the installation before trying again.
